events.title: Arrival at Eldrathor
events.description: Elarion Voss and the cohort of seventeen-year-olds enter the Royal Arcane Academy.

events.title: Royal Consort Tournament
events.description: At eighteen, eligible omegas enter the tournament; princes date and choose consorts.

events.title: First Death, First Echo
events.description: Elarion dies and resets to Academy arrival with full memory — known only to him.
